title: Create bin/rocket.ts entry point
description: Create the CLI entry point file at bin/rocket.ts. This file is the executable that npm installs globally as the 'rocket' command. It must have the correct Unix shebang, import the Commander program from src/cli.ts, and invoke it with process.argv.
acceptanceCriteria: File imports the program from src/cli.ts
Compiled to bin/rocket.js by the TypeScript build
node bin/rocket.js --help prints usage without errors

steps.description: Create bin/ directory and bin/rocket.ts file
steps.details: Create the bin/ directory at project root. Create bin/rocket.ts with the shebang as the very first line: #!/usr/bin/env node. This must be the first line with no blank lines before it.
Add the import statement: `import { program } from '../src/cli.js'`. Note the .js extension is required for NodeNext module resolution even though the source file is .ts.
Add: `await program.parseAsync(process.argv)`. Wrap in an async IIFE if needed: `(async () => { await program.parseAsync(process.argv) })()`

steps.description: Update tsconfig to include bin/ directory
steps.details: Ensure tsconfig.json (or tsconfig.bin.json) includes the bin/ directory in compilation. The compiled output bin/rocket.js must have the shebang line preserved. Check that tsc preserves the shebang comment.
After build, run `chmod +x bin/rocket.js` or add a postbuild script to package.json that does this. Alternatively, npm handles this automatically when bin entries are used.

Run `node bin/rocket.js --help` (or `npx tsx bin/rocket.ts --help` before building). Should print the CLI help text without errors. If src/cli.ts doesn't exist yet, create a minimal stub that exports an empty Commander program.

technicalNotes: The shebang line (#!/usr/bin/env node) must be the VERY first line — TypeScript compilers sometimes add a newline before it which breaks the shebang
NodeNext resolution requires .js extensions in imports even for .ts source files
The bin/rocket.js file needs execute permissions (chmod +x) to run as a global command
